data.name: Jafariyah
data.gender_notes: Jafariyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jafariyah is derived from the name Jafar, which refers to the descendants of Jafar al-Tayyar, a close companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Jafariyah carries the meaning “Descendant of Jafar” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jafariyah usually hope their child will grow to embody descendant of jafar and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes loyalty, dedication, and commitment to one's faith and community.
data.etymology: Jafariyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Descendant of Jafar.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jafariyah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
